messages:
maya: quick sync — we're proposing a new X-Route-Priority header to help route traffic to weighted pools and keep quota attribution accurate. want feedback on SDK impact and console mapping.
ben: sgtm conceptually. is the header just a hint or a hard directive?
sam: it's a hint. runtime will respect it when available and fall back to policy routing.
maya: correct — hint only. if header present, routing service will prefer matching pool but still apply quota ledger rules.
anya: Python SDK question — will we encode priority as int or string? current routehint is a JSON blob in header.
ryan: TS/Go libs prefer typed fields. can we make header a compact string like "p=10;pool=nlr" to avoid parsing JSON in lower-level clients?
ben: compact form + formal ABNF in the spec. console can parse both forms.
maya: proposal: support both forms. SDKs should default to structured meta in client libs and emit compact header for wire. e.g. 
```
X-Route-Priority: p=10;pool=nlr;source=console
```
This keeps wire small and backwards compatible.
anya: ok. for py-sdk we can add RouteMeta dataclass and a to_wire() method. default stays None. breaking?
maya: not breaking. it's an additive optional param on existing call surfaces. we need to coordinate major/minor version bumps per language though.
ryan: Go/TS: we can add options struct with RouteMeta pointer/optional field. publish patch that adds the type but not changes behavior. then a minor release that emits header when field set.
sam: telemetry: we need a new console tile mapping route-priority -> quota attribution. that requires ingest changes (route_meta field) and sample-level tagging for cost breakdowns.
ben: console UX: show effective routing and quota owner. fallback should indicate "policy-chosen" if header absent.
maya: rollout plan draft:
- phase 1 (canary): add header emitter in dev SDKs + runtime reader. ingest route_meta to telemetry but don't change billing.
- phase 2 (opt-in): allow customers to opt-in to credit routing decisions to header via tenant flag. console shows comparison.
- phase 3 (switch): if metrics look good, flip default for new tenants; existing tenants get opt-in prompt.
ryan: timelines?
maya: canary next week (mon), opt-in in 3 weeks, switch in 8 weeks.
anya: tests: need unit + e2e where SDK emits both JSON and compact forms and runtime accepts both. I'll open a py-sdk PR and include test vectors.
sam: make sure the ingestion pipeline slices by route_meta.p and stores as string to avoid costly schema migration.
ben: will add a console dashboard mock — showing "Requested Priority" vs "Applied Pool" and "Quota Charged To".
ciara-bot: deployment-check: runtime-readers-service: 2/3 green, ingest-pipeline: 3/3 green, console-mock: pending.
maya: thanks. action items: anya open py-sdk draft, ryan open ts/go issues, ben add console mock, sam update ingestion spec. I'll post the spec doc after this thread. :thumbsup:
ryan: ping me if you want help with the ts client wire format encoder.
anya: will do. starting PR today.
ben: tagging @maya to review console mock once posted.
maya: will review. this looks good — small follow-up: add telemetry sampling note to avoid overwhelming existing dashboards.
sam: noted — will add sampling param and sampling-level telemetry flag in ingestion spec.
maya: perfect, closing for now.
